data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool error in the qwen model, which failed to process post.install due to an HTTP 400 API error, forcing an inconclusive overall verdict. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review post.install due to an HTTP 400 API error, leaving a coverage gap that was only resolved by the deepseek model's successful review.
learnings: Implement retry logic for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) on a per-file basis to prevent a single file failure from rendering the entire package audit inconclusive.

When running multiple models in parallel, the orchestration layer should aggregate file-level verdicts. If one model fails to review a file due to a tool error, a successful review of that same file by another model should satisfy the coverage requirement and prevent an inconclusive package verdict.
